title: Three Springs and One Short Trowel
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：watermelon　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 watermelon 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1992 the gardener ① cut the watermelon that no apprentice in the garden would have described, and he said the cutting was the whole of the spring. The ② watermelon, meaning the fruit itself and not the trowel, ran three springs and stayed undescribed in the book; a watermelon, he said, is the only thing in a garden that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ watermelon in that garden had the same short trowel beside it, and the ④ watermelon at the far bed, meaning the cutting they kept for the children to plant and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A watermelon, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the gardener said the describing is the part that fills three springs.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the watermelon was the whole of the matter, meaning the coolness and not the fruit. The ⑥ watermelon, meaning the coolness and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; watermelon, he said, is either something you cut or the only word that means both a fruit and a coolness. He said the coolness is the part they remember.

By 1997 the ⑦ watermelon had become a line in a notebook, and the notebook had become an argument about the short trowel. The ⑧ watermelon of the whole thing, the gardener wrote in April, was one garden and three springs of describing; watermelon, he said, is either the cutting at the far bed or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ watermelon I remember is the fruit described in the notebook, which closed in 1999 and is still described as the quietest in the garden. A ⑩ watermelon, my mother said in 2001, is the only fruit that improves by being described; every watermelon, she said, is a coolness that has agreed to look like a fruit. She said the coolness was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 西瓜（指园子里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 西瓜（指那个西瓜本身，与小小的花铲相对）
C. 固定搭配：cut the watermelon 切这一个西瓜
D. n. 西瓜（指留给孩子们插的那一枝）
E. n. 西瓜之事（抽象总称，指一处园子的西瓜之事）
F. n. 西瓜（指园艺笔记里写到、被描述的那一个）
G. n. 西瓜、消暑（指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 消暑（抽象总称，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: cut the watermelon that no apprentice in the garden would have described
The watermelon, meaning the fruit itself and not the trowel
the watermelon at the far bed
the watermelon was the whole of the matter
the watermelon had become a line in a notebook
The watermelon of the whole thing
A watermelon, my mother said in 2001

answers.why: cut the watermelon 意为“切这一个西瓜”，1992 年那位园丁把园子里没有一位学徒肯描述的一个西瓜做了一遍。
watermelon 意为“西瓜”，指那个西瓜本身而不是小小的花铲，它经过了三个春天而在簿子上没有被描述。
watermelon 意为“西瓜”，指园子里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一把小小的花铲。
watermelon 意为“西瓜”，指最远那畦苗床的留给孩子们插的那一枝，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
watermelon 意为“西瓜、消暑”，指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个消暑就是那件事的全部。
watermelon 意为“消暑”，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个西瓜，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
watermelon 意为“西瓜”，指园艺笔记里写到、被描述的那一个，到 1997 年这一个成了园艺笔记里的一行。
watermelon 意为“西瓜之事”，园丁四月写道，整件事的西瓜之事是一处园子和三个春天的描述。
watermelon 意为“西瓜”，我记得的是园艺笔记里描述过的那一个，1999 年栽完了，至今仍被说成园子里最安静的一个。
watermelon 为抽象总称，母亲 2001 年说，西瓜是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的西瓜。
